reportPaths.description:
Array of paths to coverage report files with the same coverage report type.
If using multiple reportPaths and {@link Es#PackageCoverageReportSpec} `json`, the files will attempt to
merge before evaluating.

fileType.description:
The type of coverage file being used. `json` refers to [this format](https://github.com/gotwarlost/istanbul/blob/master/coverage.json.md),
and `json-summary` refers to [this format](https://istanbul.js.org/docs/advanced/alternative-reporters/#json-summary).

minCoverageExpectation.description: The minimum percent coverage expected for all categories of the coverage results.

title: Represents a coverage testing configuration for a {@link Es#Package}.
name: Es.PackageCoverageReportSpec
